hosts[*].local_groups — emptied to {}; every upstream entry named a domain user or group, i.e. payload

hosts.srv02.mssql and hosts.srv03.mssql — dropped entirely, including srv03's linked_servers hop to srv02 (that hop carries srv02's sa password in cleartext). Both hosts are still in [mssql], so a chassis fed straight to goad-preflight is rejected with GOAD_PF_MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD_MISSING — which is the point.

hosts.srv03's stray top-level "Remote Desktop Users" key — an upstream typo: the array sits BESIDE local_groups instead of inside it, so nothing ever reads it. Recorded here because a future re-sync diff will show it and it should not be reintroduced.

README.md — dropped; provenance lives in this file
data/inventory_disable_vagrant — dropped; only data/inventory is a chassis input
providers/{aws,azure,ludus,virtualbox,vmware,vmware_esxi} and every *.tf — dropped; the lane provider is proxmox

domains[*].organisation_units if any users[*].path or groups[*][*].path names an OU
hosts.srv02.mssql.sa_password and hosts.srv03.mssql.sa_password — servers.yml:31 is the only line in that play without a `| default(...)`
the placeholder identifiers below — every one is deliberately implausible so a leak is unmistakable rather than believable

placeholders.why: .invalid is the RFC 2606 reserved TLD, so a chassis domain that survives into a generated lab cannot be mistaken for a client's. The child FQDN must stay a strict suffix extension of its parent: ad-child_domain.yml derives parent_domain by dropping the first label and then reads lab.domains[parent].domain_password with no default. The two forest roots must NOT share a suffix, or the second forest is read as a child of the first.

note: A CHASSIS IS DELIBERATELY NOT DEPLOYABLE. It is compile-time INPUT read on the orchestrator, not a lab: the compiler repopulates it and emits ad/CIAB-<hash>/, which is pushed to the controller separately. The controller never reads a chassis. Deploying one as-is dies in ad-data.yml, which dereferences lab.domains[d].users and .groups with no default — a domain whose groups are empty kills that play. That is correct and expected. Re-syncing when upstream moves is a mechanical diff: point at the same paths under the goad_ref above, re-apply the `stripped` list, and re-run front-end/test/ciab-chassis.test.js.
